mock_mask: source section 3.2.1 applies same NYU-VAGC DR7 angular mask; all released mock rows eligible for depth cut
weights: unit; quoted marginal errors are not treated as independent noise
frame: published equatorial RA/Dec degrees; Cartesian axes (RA=0,Dec=0),(RA=90,Dec=0),north pole
basis_units: dex log10 distance ratio for every coefficient
training_split: even simulation-box ID; all its observers stay in same split
evaluation_split: odd simulation-box ID; all its observers stay in same split
physical_response_status: UNAVAILABLE; additive eta angular-shell response only
stage_repetition: Released post-selection FP outputs reused. Depth selection and angular projection repeated on each full catalogue; covariance/mean fitted only on training-box split. Upstream FP, group-richness correction and CF3 calibration not rerun.
predeclaration: Defined after reading release descriptions and one raw row; no blindness or confirmatory registration claimed.
calibration_scope: No raw-survey law: mock population, measurement-error and selection functions were tuned to data; group-richness correction and CF3 calibration not repeated.
